newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.
newsitem.headline: Singapore government securities end narrowly mixed.

text.p: Singapore government securities ended narrowly mixed on Monday in moderate trade on retail and interbank interest, dealers said.

"Treasury bill yields and bond prices were narrowly mixed today amid uncertainty over the near-term direction of the market. The interbank rate was unchanged from last Friday and volume was moderate," a local dealer said.
In treasury bills, three-months closed at a yield of 1.64/1.59 percent compared with last Friday's yield of 1.58/1.53 percent and one-year at a yield of 1.50/1.45 percent against 1.60/1.55 percent.
Among bonds, July 1998 ended at S$99.36/99.41 from last Friday's close of S$99.40/99.45, September 2001 at S$99.47/99.52 versus S$99.46/99.51 and June 2003 at S$99.14/99.19 against S$99.15/99.20.
The overnight interbank offered rate was unchanged from last Friday's 2-7/8 2-3/4 percent.
